name: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC)
short_description: CMMC is a US Department of Defense certification program that checks whether defense contractors can protect controlled unclassified information; CMMC 2.0 requires level 2 compliance based on NIST SP 800-171 controls.

evidence.quote: CMMC 2.0 enforcement became mandatory on November 10, 2025.
